correctness.rationale: For n>=4, the same-row neighborhood trace equivalence proves a,b<=1, and cross-row coincidence would require a class of size at most two, impossible since both classes have size >=n-1. The exact domination obstructions then establish four exhaustive admissible patterns. Their multinomial counting yields the stated size polynomial. Transfer moves change the nonsplit count by one; the two pure split words are isolated, all other words reach a mixed split word, the punctured Boolean cube connects the latter, and exhaustive downward degree accounting proves the edge count. The independent adjacency-based verifier checked every binary assignment for n=4..8 (87296 assignments total), every legal transfer, component sizes and edges. Boundary n=3 is excluded. Finite checks corroborate, not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: Two simultaneous locating-dominating parts are a published structural object. The theorem quantifies every ordered partition by size and shows all such partitions are within one vertex of balanced; it also determines all components and edges of the natural one-vertex transfer reconfiguration graph on an infinite, nontrivial graph family. These are exact structural and enumerative invariants not reducible to the prior existence statement, with a sharply exceptional n=3 boundary.
